selection_basis: Leakage incident decisions remain sparse. The registered toluene model SDS Section 6 supplies five operationally distinct propositions: ignition-source control, evacuation with ventilation, containment and recovery, non-sparking tools, and sealing recovered material. The existing acetone question on preventing entry into drains or enclosed places is explicitly excluded.
anti_duplication_rule: Do not restate drain or sewer entry prevention, generic fire extinguishing, or generic static-electricity grounding. Each candidate must retain a distinct leak-response decision.
